description: Free quick scan of up to 100 agent memory entries for leaked secrets (API keys, private keys, passwords), personal data and exact duplicates. Use when an agent stores long-term memory. The paid Memory Health Check (0.05 USDC) adds contradictions, vague entries and a cleaned memory.

memories.description: Up to 100 memory entries as plain strings (max 2000 chars each). Returned issues reference them as m1, m2…

name: scan_memory_secrets
title: Scan agent memory for secrets (free)
